# Mateus Mendonça Monteiro

> Backend Software Engineer. I build backend services in Go, Python, and Java, focusing on messaging and cloud infrastructure. Currently at Itaú Unibanco and doing MSc research at UNESP.

Portfolio and résumé of a backend software engineer: experience, education, skills, open-source projects and contact channels. The website is a single-page React app, prerendered to static HTML in Portuguese, English and Spanish. The files below carry the same content as plain text and as structured data, rendered at build time from the same source as the page. To answer questions about Mateus, read one Markdown profile or the JSON Resume; neither needs JavaScript.

- Current role: Software Engineer at Itaú Unibanco (since May 2026)
- Location: São Paulo, Brazil
- Education: Master's in Computer Science at UNESP (in progress); Bachelor's in Computer Science at Universidade do Oeste Paulista
- Focus: Distributed Systems, Data Engineering, Software Architecture, Data Mesh & Pipelines
- Spoken languages: Portuguese (native), English (full professional)
- Contact: matt.mendon@gmail.com
- Last updated: 2026-11-16

## Projects

- [rinha-backend-2026-c](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/rinha-backend-2026-c/): Fraud detection by vector search for Rinha de Backend 2026, in C11. KNN over 1,000,000 reference vectors in shared memory, with ARM Neon SIMD, 16-bit fixed-point quantization and 4,096 spatial buckets. Median latency near 250 µs on 1 vCPU and 350 MB. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/rinha-backend-2026-c)
- [megabrain-context-protocol](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/megabrain-context-protocol/): Material for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) workshop at DevFest 2026. Builds DevBrain, an MCP server in Python that tells a coding agent whether a branch is ready for a pull request. Review rules live in code, and the same server runs in Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Copilot and Codex. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/megabrain-context-protocol)
- [syntroph](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/syntroph/): Go toolkit and orchestrator that connects development tools around a hexagonal core. An in-process event bus hands one adapter's output to the next, an append-only saga journal records each step, and session memory stays local, with GitHub Issues or Wiki as a mirror. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/syntroph)
- [transaction.ledger](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/transaction-ledger/): Financial order registration service on AWS serverless. Implements conditional writes for idempotency, outbox pattern with CDC, circuit breakers, and CloudWatch observability. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/transaction.ledger)
- [codecash](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/codecash/): Transactional API built for the 'API Hero' workshop at DevFest 2025. Uses Spring Boot, GraphQL queries, PostgreSQL storage, and Redis caching. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/codecash)
- [8-puzzle](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/8-puzzle/): 8-puzzle solver using heuristic search with A* and Best-First Search algorithms based on Manhattan distance. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/8-puzzle)
- [fuzzymeans-ai](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/fuzzymeans-ai/): Explainable imputation of missing costs in highway-rail crossing accident records (FRA data). Fuzzy C-Means and Noise Clustering over coordinates and speeds: each imputed value is a membership-weighted mean that can be audited. Validated by masking 30% of the known values across 5 seeds. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/fuzzymeans-ai)
- [lime.stability.imputation](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/lime-stability/): MSc experimental research on LIME stability with data imputation techniques across RandomForest and GradientBoosting models. Private repository.
- [git-github-in-action](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/git-github-in-action/): Code examples and resources for the 'Git and GitHub in Action' workshop at 35th Infoeste, covering version control and workflows. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/git-github-in-action)
- [AlgorithmForest](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/algorithm-forest/): Implementation of tree data structures and algorithms in Java, including Binary Search Trees (BST) and AVL balancing. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/AlgorithmForest)
- [zhang-suen-thinning](https://mateusememe.github.io/whoami/projects/zhang-suen-thinning/): Python implementation of the Zhang-Suen morphological thinning and skeletonization algorithm for binary images. [Source](https://github.com/mateusememe/zhang-suen-thinning)
- [ai-autopsy-devfest-2025](https://github.com/mateusememe/ai-autopsy-devfest-2025): Code and slides for the 'AI Autopsy' workshop at DevFest 2025. Trains a LightGBM classifier on the Titanic dataset, then explains single predictions and global behavior with LIME and SHAP.
- [llm-edu-cards](https://github.com/mateusememe/llm-edu-cards): Streamlit app that generates study cards with Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct: a summary for any topic and related subtopics to explore as a tree. Bilingual interface. Built for the Deep Learning course of the UNESP graduate program.
- [iron.ledger](https://github.com/mateusememe/iron.ledger): Python SDK and CLI that import workout programs into Hevy through its official API. Maps exercises by fuzzy matching, validates before upload, retries with exponential backoff on HTTP 429 and keeps imports idempotent.
- [search.it](https://github.com/mateusememe/search.it): Command-line search over movie files, written for the LuizaLabs search team technical challenge. Builds an in-memory inverted index and answers term queries with a result limit and match counts. Compiled to a native binary with GraalVM.
- [kruskal-algorithm](https://github.com/mateusememe/kruskal-algorithm): Python implementation of Kruskal's greedy algorithm for the minimum spanning tree.
- [whoami](https://github.com/mateusememe/whoami): This site. React and TypeScript, prerendered at build time, with a three.js layer where a particle field morphs between six formations, canvas covers that run each project's algorithm, and llms.txt, Markdown and JSON Resume for agents.

## Open-source contributions

- [dmux/go-quality-gate](https://github.com/dmux/go-quality-gate/pull/32): Detection of the runtime and tools a project needs, with install hints per operating system. Extended `doctor` command, a `tools_policy: recommend` setting and the `check_environment` MCP tool for AI agents. 25 files, 1,353 lines added.
- [leeozaka/Merkle](https://github.com/leeozaka/Merkle/pulls?q=is%3Apr+author%3Amateusememe+is%3Amerged): Two language adapters for Merkle's Protocol 1.0, one for Java and Spring Boot and one for Python. Each runs out of process and does language detection, deterministic AST indexing and test impact mapping.
- [zanfranceschi/rinha-de-backend-2026](https://github.com/zanfranceschi/rinha-de-backend-2026/pull/7621): Submission accepted in the fourth Rinha de Backend: fraud detection with vector search, limited to 1 vCPU and 350 MB. The code is the rinha-backend-2026-c project.
